analysis:
This PR changes only documentation: a new changelog fragment (changelog.d/gptoss-stop-in-final-channel.md, lines 1-9) and one table row in docs/architecture/inference.md (changed at line 1846; the supplied base excerpt ends at line 805, so the changed row itself is only visible in the patch). The documented behavior is that GPT-OSS client `stop` sequences match only the Harmony `final` channel, via `ModelEOSPolicy.stopStringScope` and `StopHoldback`. Analysis and tool-call frames are never cut, and the reported stop sequence replays the same scope.

No code, key handling, attestation, encryption, authorization, cache, or WebSocket paths are modified in this diff. The described runtime behavior touches TB-007, the inference engine, and TB-002, response framing. It is an availability/correctness fix: previously a stop string hit during reasoning ended the request with an empty answer. Nothing visible weakens the T-008 fail-closed encryption of response chunks, T-010 cancellation, or the T-041 cache isolation. Stop matching is applied before encryption on the provider side and does not expose plaintext.

Open questions are limited to the unseen Swift implementation (StopHoldback, ModelEOSPolicy, EngineV2Bridge+StopSequence). I could not verify from the supplied evidence that it behaves as documented, for example that held-back text cannot leak past a stop sequence in the final channel, or that a tool-call argument is never emitted unfiltered. A docs-only change cannot establish a regression, so I record these as unverified contracts rather than findings. The next pass should review the actual source diff if one exists in another batch.
